verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page names ISO 27001 as a supported framework, and its docs describe adding frameworks that automatically bring in their own controls, so ISO 27001 is a first-party framework rather than an outside workaround. Nothing in the evidence shows how deep that support goes. Missing for 10: documentation of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation, certification-audit artifacts or auditor workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of ISO 27001 depth.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped

citations.quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework. Oneleet's all-in-one platform simplifies your compliance journey.
Removing a framework also removes unused controls that were automatically added for it.
